The '''Crafted Blight''' was the name given to the southwestern section of the [[Nightmare Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. It was the site of several ancient ruins, as well as where the entity [[Sel-Makor]] had some of the people under his control build strange structures that seemed to extend the edge of the Nightmare Lands' corruption.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Crafted Blight appears as an area on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
